data: Target an enemy NPC and consume it for 170% Bonus Souls and grants a powerful long lasting buff.
Reduces the effect of enemy applied healing reduction.
Walking through a cosmic veil grants you Stealth, Heal and increased Move Speed.
Your Melee Attack applies Movement Slow and heals you for a percentage of the Melee Damage dealt plus a fixed amount.
This heal is 40% effective vs non-heroes.
Cooldown is 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits.
Landing a Headshot reduces their Bullet Resist.
Become Stealthed. Whenever you take damage while Stealthed you get briefly revealed.
Attacking or using an ability will end your stealth and start an ambush, temporarily granting you bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Melee Damage.
Slows movement of enemy target. Also Silences their movement-based items and abilities.
Does not affect target's stamina usage.
When an enemy uses an ability within 32mm range from you, store one Restoration Stack.
Consume all stacks to heal yourself and replenish up to 3 stamina based on how many stacks you have.
Charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, causing abilities dealing more than 165 damage to deal additional damage. Ignores Spirit Resistance.
Target an enemy to Silence them. A portion of all damage dealt during the silence gets applied to the target when the silence wears off.
Gain bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Spirit Lifesteal by charging up when shooting enemy heroes.
Gain souls over time, as long as you are alive.
Hatch the egg, gaining souls and permanent buffs.
The value of the egg grows the longer you hold onto it.
Gain a permanent buff per 80 Souls accrued when hatched.
When you are above 65% health, deal additional Weapon Damage and your bullets reduce enemy Bullet Resist.
Upon casting an ultimate ability gain a Barrier and temporary Spirit Power.
Heal and gain bonus Movement Speed for a short duration when you cast an ability.
Whenever you score an assist or kill, gain extra sprint, ability range and passive soul generation. This effect stacks and persists through death.
Inflict damage over time to a target, dealing damage based on their current health.
Decay's damage is non-lethal and does not apply item procs.
Imbue an ability with increased range. Dealing damage with that ability grants you increased weapon damage per unique hero hit. Has reduced effect on non-heroes.
Gain a chance to either deflect incoming bullets, preventing all weapon damage or prevent all on-hit effects from bullets.
After not taking damage for a period, gain health regen.
When you are above 75% health, you have bonus Move Speed.
Your bullets build up a Bleed on enemies, causing them to lose a percentage of their Max Health over time. Also applies Healing Reduction on the bleeding target.

Your imbued ability charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, bonus fire rate, and reloads bullets on use. Until your next reload, your bullets deal bonus spirit damage based on your Spirit Power.
Sacrifice some of your health to launch a bomb that deals damage after a brief arm time.
Self damage type is Spirit and can be mitigated.
Bombs leave a toxic mess on the ground, dealing 30.0% of the original damage per second, for 6s.

Create a tether that drains enemy health over time and heals you. Target must be in line of sight and within max range to drain. You can shoot and use other abilities during the drain, but your move speed is reduced.
to give health to friendly Heroes.
Enables and Grants +2 Charges. Increases spirit scaling.
Gain bonus defensive attributes. Taking damage grants temporary regeneration for a portion of the damage taken.
Leap high into the air before crashing into the ground, dealing spirit damage and applying stun.
On cast, become Unstoppable for 5s and +6m Impact Radius

Deal weapon damage to summon cards of a random suit. Each card can be thrown, dealing damage and applying a different effect depending of its suit. Cards thrown fly towards the enemy or point under your crosshair.
All suits are improved and higher chance for Jokers
300 Barrier for 5s. Barrier scales with Spirit Power.
Temporarily boosts your fire rate and deal bonus spirit damage
Unlimited Ammo and Increased Scaling on Spirit Damage Per Bullet
Charge up a powerful shot of time energy, dealing spirit damage and applying a Time-Stop to enemies hit. The damage dealt increases with weapon damage. Move speed is increased while charging.
While in the air and charging, to timeslow your movement.
+2s Charge Hold Duration and +55% Damage Scaling
Target yourself or a Hero to freeze the air and create an impenetrable dome around them. While in the dome, allies gain rapid regeneration and enemies are slowed.
Objectives becomes Invulnerable and Frozen under Frozen Shelter
Purges non-ult debuffs for you and your allies.
+65 Health Regen and increased Spirit Scaling
Shooting a target increases your bullet damage on that target. Gain one stack per bullet hit, three if the hit is a headshot.
40.0 Spirit damage and 12% slow for 2s to target every 20 stacks
Headshots deal bonus Damage and applies a Fading Move Speed penalty. This effect can only occur when off cooldown.
Cooldown is reduced by 50% on NPC hits.
Crackshot ignores range damage fall-off and does not apply to objectives.
-6s Cooldown on Hero Headshots. -3s on NPC Headshots
Throw out your lasso, dealing spirit damage, pulling, and applying stun.
Using a Bounce Pad extends the duration of Spirit Lasso.
Throw a knife that bleeds an enemy. Each additional hit adds a stack and refreshes the bleed duration, causing the bleed to increase per stack.
+12.0 Bleed DPS with increased Spirit scaling
Turn yourself into impervious stone and smash into the ground, stunning and damaging enemies nearby. Heals you for a percentage of your max health.
+0.75s Stun Duration and increased Damage spirit scaling
Throw a flask that damages and reduces the weapon damage and move speed of enemies it hits.
Gain a Barrier and bonus move speed.
+30% Debuff Resistance and improved Barrier scaling
Throw a grappling hook to reel yourself towards an enemy, dealing Light melee damage and slowing the target when you arrive.
Slash enemies in front of you, damaging them and slowing their fire rate. If any enemy heroes are hit, you heal.
On Hero Hit : +6% Max Health Heal
Stomp the ground beneath you, damaging enemies in front of you. If you perform Ground Strike while airborne, you quickly dive towards the ground. Damage grows slower after 25m.
Struck enemies are knocked up and slowed by 40% for 3s
Damage Per Meter +120% and improved scaling
Pull yourself through the air toward a target. Using Grapple also resets your limit of air jumps and dashes.
+20m Cast Range and gain +7.0 Weapon Damage for 6s
Strike enemies in front of you with your whip, healing for a portion of the damage dealt.
Throw a ball of goo that deals damage and leaves puddles of goo behind that apply movement slow to enemies in the radius.
Bounces 1 times and improves Spirit Scaling

Encase the target in a cube of restorative goo that protects from damage, and increases health regen. Target is unable to take any new actions while cubed. Can be used on self. Press Jump / mantle to escape early.
Increases Move Speed and Stamina Recovery
Removes all non-ult Debuffs and -20.0s Cooldown
Materialize a fist in the world that punches everyone in the area, applying knockup.
Punching an enemy deals melee damage and applies slow.
You and your allies have increased Air Control.
-14.0s Cooldown and now deals Heavy Melee Damage
Morph into a large goo ball that deals damage and stuns enemies on impact. The ball grants large amounts of Bullet and Spirit resist, bounces off walls and can double jump.
+7s Duration, +0.3s Stun Duration, and +0.2 Spirit Scaling
You have increased Slide Distance, can Slide up hills, and can turn faster while Sliding.
Throw an explosive bola. On exploding, the bola Slows and Damages all enemies in the area.
Direct hits deal Additional Damage and Petrify instead. Petrified units block all damage, but cannot take actions.
+1.0s Petrify Duration. Petrifies all enemies in the area.
Load your crossbow with 3 stakes, dealing massively increased weapon damage.
The final stake is blessed, dealing bonus pure damage and executing low-health enemies.
While Active: Gain 1.2 m/s Move Speed
Target an area with latent magic, applying slow.
The magic detonates after a delay, dealing spirit damage and applying immobilize.
On Hit: Reduce Spirit Resist by -18% for 6s
Release a wave of spectral knights and steeds that charge across the entire city, healing allies and dealing spirit damage to enemies.
The strength of the heal and spirit damage is amplified as the knights travel further.
Signal a Helper to lend a hand. They can collect boxes, do Sinner's Sacrifices, or be sent to support allies and troopers.
Follow a hero: Provides a short burst of spirit resist and fading move speed.
Follow a trooper: Provides healing, damage, resists, and allows tagging along. When no hero is around, souls from trooper kills are split amongst the team.
Can be cast during Tag Along. Helpers will take a nap for 15.1s after following someone.
+80 Bonus Damage and kicked enemies deal -35% Damage for 5s
Throw a bola, dealing spirit damage, applying slow and preventing movement abilities or stamina.
Blast enemies in a cone in front of you with a flare of light. Blasted enemies take spirit damage when attacked by Celeste and provides her spirit lifesteal.
Surround yourself in a protective prism. If the barrier is destroyed, it silences nearby enemies and deals a portion of the barrier as damage.
+70 Barrier and Increased Barrier Spirit Scaling
+1.25 Silence Duration and -20s Cooldown. Allows Shining Wonder Bounce.
Call down a beam of light from the sky. After a short duration, the beam will fully form, causing an explosion that deals spirit damage to all targets in the area.
Celeste will receive a stacking buff that increases her spirit damage anytime this hits an enemy hero.

Launch a deadly orb of light that deals spirit damage and applies slow and reduces Dash Distance on impact. The orb then bounces to the enemies within range. If no target is found, the orb will linger for a short duration while continuing to look for targets.
Prioritizes enemy heroes when picking targets.
